stem:
Read this sentence from paragraph 5 of the selection “A Massive Mission.”

Every day people come to see the shuttle that flew so many daring missions into space.

Which sentence from the selection “DO Look Down!” includes a similar idea?

options.label: A
options.text: Though it would take a great amount of work, many tribe members liked this idea; they felt the skywalk would provide job opportunities. (paragraph 4)

options.label: B
options.text: It is strong enough to hold the weight of 71 airplanes. (paragraph 5)

options.label: C
options.text: Since then the $30 million attraction has welcomed millions of visitors. (paragraph 6)

options.label: D
options.text: The Hualapai have future plans to add businesses and a museum. (paragraph 6)

visual_elements: Every day people come to see the shuttle that flew so many daring missions into space.
